info.title: Mac MCP Server
info.description: OpenAPI schema for connecting Mac MCP Server to Custom GPT Actions. Every MCP tool is exposed as one named REST operation; legacy grouped REST endpoints remain available for compatibility but are intentionally omitted from this published schema.

servers.description: Replace with your own static ngrok dev domain.

post.summary: Run a shell command on macOS using zsh
post.description: Runs a local command and returns bounded output and timing information.
Returns immediately with a job_id. Use get_job_status, get_job_output, and stop_job to manage it.

timeout_s.description: Maximum runtime in seconds; capped by the server.

no_output_timeout_s.description: Terminate if no output is produced for this many seconds.

tail_lines.description: Return only the last N lines.

since_offset.description: Return output after this byte offset.

post.summary: Wait for background jobs to finish
post.description: Returns a bounded response even when a job is still running.

timeout_s.description: Maximum wait in seconds; the response is bounded.

post.summary: Run independent shell commands in parallel
Write multiple files in one call

length.description: Maximum number of lines to return.

post.summary: Read multiple files in one call
Find and replace text in a file
Move or rename a file or directory
Create a directory and its parents

pattern.description: Glob pattern such as *.py or report*.

path.description: Root directory; defaults to the current user's home.

post.description: The server terminates timed-out AppleScript process groups.

timeout_s.description: Timeout in seconds; hard-capped by the server.

post.summary: Write text to the Mac clipboard

content.description: Text to place on the clipboard.

app_name.description: Application name, such as Safari or Finder.

post.summary: Open a URL in the default browser
Add a reminder to macOS Reminders

due_date.description: Optional date such as month/day/year HH:MM AM/PM.

post.description: Returns an observation_id and Accessibility nodes with element_id values for mac_act.

app.description: Optional application; defaults to the frontmost app.

ocr.description: Use OCR only when Accessibility text is insufficient.

post.description: Use observation_id for safe targeting. The complete batch has a bounded safety budget.

items.description: Action object; supported types include click, double_click, scroll, type, paste, key, shortcut, drag, accessibility_action, and menu.

return_state.description: Return a fresh UI state after acting.

pattern.description: Text or regular expression to search for.

path.description: Root directory; defaults to the current user's home.

items.description: Extension such as py or js.

post.summary: Search file names with macOS Spotlight
Open a URL in Safari or Google Chrome
Execute JavaScript in a browser tab
Click a browser element by CSS selector
Type text into a browser element
Press a key in a browser

items.description: Modifier such as cmd or shift.

post.summary: Read the visible browser DOM tree
Ask the local user an interactive question
post.description: Use during autonomous tasks when a local answer or missing information is needed.

question.description: Question shown in a native macOS dialog.

post.summary: Ask the user to choose from native buttons
post.description: Cancel and timeout return a bounded result without leaving a background process.

question.description: Question shown in the native dialog.

choices.description: Two to three native button labels.

post.summary: Ask the user for explicit Yes/No confirmation
post.description: Only an explicit confirm button produces confirmed=true; deny, cancel, close, and timeout are false.

question.description: Question shown in the native dialog.
